source_issue.title: Header UI not consistant for Tablet size view port

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses a bug in the Volto project where the header interface does not display consistently on tablet-sized screens. Instead of the navigation links stacking in a column, they remain in a row, which can lead to a confusing user experience.

## What needs to be done
The dropdown menu that appears in the header when viewed on a tablet should have its navigation links arranged in a column format, similar to how they are displayed on mobile phones. This change will involve modifying the CSS styles for the menu.

## Helpful background
The issue has been confirmed, and multiple users have expressed interest in fixing it. Currently, the menu layout uses Semantic UI’s stackable menu, which only changes to a column format below 768px. The goal is to adjust styling so that a column layout is applied for tablet views as well, specifically addressing the CSS in `main.less` and `Navigation.jsx`.

## Good first steps
1. **Familiarize yourself with the project**: Check out the Volto and contributing guidelines [here](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/index.html).
2. **Review the relevant files**: Look at `Navigation.jsx` and `main.less` to understand the current setup.
3. **Set up a local development environment**: Clone the repository and check for the bug in a tablet simulator (around 850px view).
4. **Propose a fix**: Once you've identified a solution, make a pull request that implements the necessary changes.
